evidence.reason: The catch at line 172 maps every non-AccountingGitError to exit code 3. The guarded block performs direct filesystem calls such as readFile and atomicWrite, whose EIO failures are not AccountingGitError, so execution/I/O failures are reported as needs-human instead of thrown-error exit 1. Explicit operator-refusal errors can remain 3; this is an ordinary exit-code classification defect, not a request to expand scope.
